name: DateTimeField
description:
DateTimeInput bound to a `string | null` form field holding a wall clock (`2026-10-21T09:30`).
Pair it with `dateTimeSchema()` and the same locale, bounds and zone. One label names both
parts; one message line serves both. An incomplete or unreadable entry reaches the form as
read, so the schema names the part to fix.
signature: ({ label, hint, warning, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, describe, ...control }: DateTimeFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the group when no Field label names it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that name the group.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: dateLabel
props.description: Accessible names of the two parts (default "Date", "Time").

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: The time filled in when a day is entered or picked before any time ("09:00").

props.name: describe
props.description:
With `timeZone`, describe the zone as the hint when none is given ("Australia/Sydney · UTC+11:00"),
and explain a time a daylight-saving change skips (a warning) or repeats. Default true.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Override the locale's clock: 12 (am/pm) or 24.

props.name: id
props.description: The date input's id; a Field label points at it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale: the date order, the clock and names. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest allowed wall-clock date and time.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed wall-clock date and time.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the date input, for focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: size
props.description: The box height, matching DateField.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between suggested times, and between arrow-key steps on the minutes (default 15).

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Explicit times to offer in the list instead of every `step` minutes.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the time part (default "Time").

props.name: timeZone
props.description:
IANA zone the wall clock is read in ("Australia/Sydney"). Shown in the box as its
abbreviation or offset on that date; the list leaves out times a daylight-saving change
skips. The value never converts: use `resolveWallClock` for the instant.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). Default medium.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
